ImageDescription.value: I don't know if any of us has enough gumption to be reincarnated as wild salmon. These fish are nearing the end of their amazing and perilous journey up the Yukon River when seen here in the holding pen at the top of the fishladder at the Whitehorse power dam. Every stroke and gasp is dedicated to reaching a grand finale far up a mountain stream. Only the fittest (and luckiest) of the species will spawn in the gravel bed where each began its great circle of life.

ImageDescription.value: The Chattar Manzil (Hindi: छतर मंज़िल, Urdu: چھتر منزل‎), or Umbrella Palace, was constructed by order of Nawab Ghazi Uddin Haider and completed after his death by his successor, Nawab Nasir Uddin Haider.It is opposite Hotel Clarks Avadh,Lucknow. The imposing building has large underground rooms and a dome surmounted by a gilt umbrella. From the time of the Indian Rebellion of 1857 it was often photographed by such figures as Felice Beato, Samuel Bourne, Darogha Ubbas Alli, and Thomas Rust.
